group.description: project (default), user, or recent; user and recent need the Wizard app running

expect_revision.description: Optional autosave bundle_version; when given it must equal the current project revision, else stale_revision. remove_swatch with an index requires it.

index.description: When names repeat: the index of the swatch with this name, from the latest color.list_swatches (remove also needs that call's bundle_version as expect_revision)

name.description: Project swatch name (exact after trimming; ASCII letters match in any case)

expect_revision.description: Optional autosave bundle_version expected by the caller; enforced by dispatch (Tier-1): a stale expectation on a targeted clip is rejected with stale_revision and the current revision to retry with. Ops that target no clip (timeline/track/settings/asset mutations) only require the revision to be a known bundle_version — best-effort under concurrency, per-clip collisions are the Tier-1 scope
